annotations.title: Get a download link for one of my files

description: A one-time, 2-minute download link for one file of your own app or subscription (needs ref from my_apps_list and asset_ref from my_app_get). The link only works when opened in a browser where you are signed in to Barmaan as the same account; it cannot be used once, after it expires, or if the subscription is no longer active. Returns the site path (not a public URL), file name, size and SHA-256.

asset_ref.description: File reference from my_app_get, e.g. AST-ABCD2345.

ref.description: Item reference from my_apps_list, e.g. ENT-ABCD2345.
